description: A named test is registered and executed by the engine. A test carries a human-readable name and a body of zero or more relational expectations. When executed, the engine reports the test name, an executed status, and the aggregate assertion counts: the total number of expectations evaluated, how many passed, and how many failed. A test may instead be marked to be skipped, in which case it reports its name and a skipped status and its body is never evaluated. These cases probe an empty name, an all-failing body, a larger all-passing body, and a skipped test that still carries a body.

cases.expected_output:
test=all fail
status=executed
asserts=2
passed=0
failed=2

test=many checks
status=executed
asserts=3
passed=3
failed=0
